423 RENTAL HOMES. COMPLETED HOUSING SUPPLY.

The Travis has added 423 apartments at 80 Red River Street in downtown Austin’s Rainey Street district.

A November 12 report from REBusinessOnline covers the completed project by Genesis Real Estate Group and architect KTGY. The architect’s November 2 announcement lists the opening as August 2026—so this is fresh coverage of an earlier opening, not 423 homes delivered this week.

The project includes studios through three-bedroom apartments and penthouse offerings. REBusinessOnline reports studio rents starting around $3,000 a month, placing it in the higher-priced downtown rental segment.

Why it matters: this is completed rental supply, beyond the proposal or construction stage. It adds options in one specific part of Austin’s market; its completion alone does not establish a citywide rent trend or tell us how many apartments remain available.

For renters comparing downtown options, the useful next questions are current availability, total monthly costs and lease terms.

Sources: REBusinessOnline, November 12, 2026; KTGY, November 2, 2026.
